{{Quote|You have performed beyond your parameters.|Nute Gunray|audio=OOM9reallygood.flac|<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
'''OOM-9''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] created by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. OOM-9 was selected to serve as a [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|command battle droid]] for the invasion, leading [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|forces]] into battle and achieving great success in the early stages of the campaign. Under the [[Battle droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]], Trade Federation [[Troop/Legends|troops]] defeated the forces of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] at [[Harte Secur]] and [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] before [[Capture of Theed/Legends|capturing]] the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

When news of a primitive [[Species/Legends|species]] residing in the planet's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]&mdash;the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]&mdash;reached the Trade Federation, OOM-9 was charged with hunting them down but had limited success. When the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] arrived to take control of the Federation forces, he personally recovered information that led to OOM-9 [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|forcing]] the evacuation of the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].

The invasion ultimately turned against the Trade Federation when the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] rallied to the cause of Naboo [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and moved to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|engage]] the Trade Federation Droid Army on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]]. OOM-9 was once again charged with leading the battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to victory and soon overwhelmed the Gungan forces. However, the concurrent [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle went against the Trade Federation, seeing the destruction of a [[Vuutun Palaa|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]]. With the loss of the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|control ship]], OOM-9 and his troops powered down, halting on the verge of victory.

==Biography==
===Blockade of Naboo===
OOM-9 was created by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]]<ref name="SV49">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|49|Droids, Aliens & Creatures}}</ref> for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="GB" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="32BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] as depicted in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> to serve in their [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] under the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], along with his senior staff [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] and [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]].<ref name="GB" /> Although otherwise a standard [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]],<ref name="GB" /> OOM-9's production group was designated to [[Commanding officer/Legends|command duties]] and received some supplementary programming.<ref name="SV49" /> Since the B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] did not have a standard alphanumeric series designation, the name "OOM-9" was selected for the unit from a shortened version of the unique identification code assigned to the battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="NEGD" />

[[File:OOM-9_databank.png|thumb|left|250px|OOM-9, flanked by two battle droids]]
In 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="32BBY" /> Gunray, having led the Trade Federation into a pact with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], initiated a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="TPM" /> in the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> as a protest to the new taxation of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] and began making plans for an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]].<ref name="TPM" /> OOM-9 was one of several [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|command droids]] that would lead Trade Federation forces against the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] population. In order to ensure simple communication between the Neimoidians and their forces,<ref name="FF81">{{FactFile|81|BAT 7-10|Trade Federation Battle Droids}}</ref> OOM-9 was arbitrarily designated as the senior command droid<ref name="SV49" /> and chosen to act as a single point of contact,<ref name="FF81" /> for which he received some additional programming.<ref name="SV49" />

Sidious, who was secretly [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine of Naboo, had an [[Grand Plan/Legends|ulterior motive]] for the invasion, intending to use it to undermine the leadership of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] and allow him to advance his own position. Valorum, hoping to resolve the crisis, [[Mission to Naboo|sent]] two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;to settle the dispute. The arrival of the Jedi forced Sidious to accelerate the timeline for his plan's execution; the Dark Lord ordered Gunray to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Jedi and begin landing his forces.<ref name="TPM" /> OOM-9's first assignment as a commander was to organize the Trade Federation forces for the invasion.<ref name="GB" />

===Communications disruption===
{{Quote|I have a task for you, OOM-9. Destroy the communications capability of the Naboo.|Nute Gunray, to OOM-9 before the subjugation of Parrlay|audio=OOM9Task.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:TheParrlaycrew.png|thumb|right|250px|OOM-9's initial landing force arrive on Naboo.]]
Fearing that the Naboo would try to contact the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to plead for help, Gunray promptly ordered the destruction of Naboo's offworld communication capabilities, with OOM-9 being selected to lead the mission ahead of the main invasion force. Gunray gave the droid commander his orders personally: to [[Subjugation of Parrlay|occupy]] the Naboo settlements of [[Parrlay]], [[New Centrif]], and [[Vis/Legends|Vis]] and to raze their communications buildings to the ground.<ref name="GB" /> Landing just north of New Centrif<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> in a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], his small force of [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] (STAP), [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]], battle droids, and his personal [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Heavy Armored Assault Tank]] was unprepared for a major fight and was ordered to avoid direct confrontations with the Naboo until reinforcements could arrive. Since the Trade Federation could not afford to alert the Naboo to their presence on the ground they could not risk conducting long-range scans, leaving OOM-9's forces to locate the settlements without reconnaissance data.<ref name="GB" />

The Federation forces proceeded south to New Centrif, but the settlement was too heavily defended, prompting OOM-9 to seek reinforcements before returning to attack it. Turning east, the droid led his force toward the smaller settlement of Vis. Upon arriving, Gunray contacted OOM-9 to alert him to the arrival of the promised reinforcements led by the battle droid [[EEK-176]], which consisted of [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] and additional battle droids and beetle droids. With EEK-176's unit approaching from the east, OOM-9 moved into Vis from the west. The two forces converged on the [[City/Legends|city]], killing the Naboo forces they encountered and destroying its communication transmitter.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:WhoPutTreesInTheWay-TPM.png|thumb|left|320px|OOM-9 oversees the advance of Trade Federation forces.]]
Proceeding out of Vis along a country road, OOM-9 took his combined forces to the less-defended south entrance to New Centrif, where they engaged workers and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] guarding a number of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystal]] deposits. The attack drew the attention of the Naboo forces in New Centrif, and the majority of the city's population descended upon the Trade Federation troops. OOM-9's droids defeated them before proceeding into the city to eliminate the last surviving defenders, while his beetle droids razed the city.<ref name="Prima" />

OOM-9 next moved south toward his final goal, the larger city of Parrlay, encountering several Naboo patrols along the way. After locating Parrlay, the OOM commander was once more contacted by Gunray, who instructed him to destroy its transmitter before the inhabitants could contact their capital city, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. To assist OOM-9 in his task, Gunray dispatched further reinforcements, consisting of additional beetle droids and droidekas, along with [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]] and AATs.<ref name="GB" /> Proceeding into Parrlay, the Trade Federation forces advanced south until reaching the wall surrounding the city's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. OOM-9 placed his [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] along the wall to engage Naboo defenders, while his heavy units blasted through the wall, allowing them to proceed inside and destroy the spaceport and transmitter.<ref name="Prima" />

===Jedi escape===
{{Quote|Yes, Viceroy?''"<br />"''Captain, we've searched the ship and there is no trace of the Jedi. They may have gotten on one of your landing craft.''"<br />"''If they're down here, sir, we'll find them.|OOM-9 receives orders from Rune Haako|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:OOMNineOrders.jpg|thumb|right|270px|OOM-9 receives orders from Nute Gunray and Rune Haako.]]
The victory at Parrlay was just the beginning of the Trade Federation's plans,<ref name="GB" /> and they began landing their main invasion force on Naboo. As OOM-9 oversaw the disembarkation of his forces from their [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]], he was contacted by Gunray and Haako. Their attempt to kill Jinn and Kenobi had failed, and a thorough search of the [[Saak'ak/Legends|flagship]] had failed to find any trace of them. The Neimoidians had correctly concluded that the Jedi had escaped to the surface of the planet by stowing away aboard a C-9979 landing craft.<ref name="TPM" />

OOM-9 assured his superiors that if the Jedi were on the planet, his forces would find them.<ref name="TPM" /> The droid commander ordered that both the patrol grid for STAPs and the number of ground battle droids be doubled.<ref name="GB" /> Despite his effort, the Jedi were able to elude capture by his forces; the Trade Federation nevertheless remained unconcerned by this failure and continued to push ahead with the invasion.<ref name="TPM" />

===Harte Secur===
{{Quote|Your army is online. Destroy Harte Secur!|Nute Gunray, to OOM-9|audio=ArmyOnline.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:DeactivatedCamp-SWGB.png|thumb|left|300px|OOM-9 arrives at OOM-14's command center.]]
Soon after the full-scale invasion began, one of the five [[droid control program]]s sent to Naboo with the initial landing force was captured from the command droid [[OOM-14/Legends|OOM-14]] by Naboo [[Force Command Two|troops]] and taken to a [[Research Center|research center]] near the city of [[Harte Secur]]. The loss of the control program rendered OOM-14's forces immobile. Furthermore, Gunray knew that if the Naboo could replicate the program, they could take control of the Trade Federation's own battle droids.<ref name="GB" />

With the control program in enemy hands, the Trade Federation could not risk a large force to retrieve it.<ref name="GB" /> Using [[Jammer/Legends|communications jamming]] to prevent the Naboo from spreading the program,<ref name="Prima" /> Gunray contacted OOM-9 and told him to escort a [[Unidentified Neimoidian technician (Harte Secur)|Neimoidian technician]] to the research center, retrieve the program, and use it to reactivate OOM-14's forces and their [[Deactivated Camp|command center]]. He was assigned a group of droidekas to assist in the attack along with a [[bio cannon]].<ref name="GB" />

Rendezvousing with the technician at OOM-14's camp,<ref name="GB" /> OOM-9 set out toward the research center, taking the road east around a large [[Forest/Legends|forest]] and eliminating the Naboo forces they encountered along the way. After arriving at the research center, the droid commander had the bio cannon destroy the defensive [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] and main gate, allowing his forces to move into the facility and retrieve the control program. Returning to OOM-14's camp, the [[Technician/Legends|technician]] soon reactivated the disabled forces, giving OOM-9 command of a large number of battle droids and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|missile battle droids]] with which he was ordered by Gunray to [[Capture of Harte Secur|destroy]] Harte Secur.<ref name="Prima" />

Despite the threat of the [[Naboo Airforce]] operating out of the nearby [[Harte Secur Airbase]], along with a neighboring Gungan settlement, OOM-9 was able to gather his forces and sweep into Harte Secur, destroying much of the city's architecture and obliterating its town center. Gunray complimented the droid on the impressive nature of the victory and announced that he had been selected to spearhead the [[Invasion of Spinnaker|attack]] on the coastal town of [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]].<ref name="GB" />

===Spoils of Spinnaker===
{{Quote|Spinnaker is Naboo's chief supply center. Your mission is to disrupt the supply lines, OOM-9.|Nute Gunray|audio=GunraySpinnaker-GB.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Spinnaker was Naboo's chief supply center, and most goods being transported between Naboo and other worlds passed through the town's spaceports. With the Trade Federation's blockade in place, the spaceports were fully loaded with valuable materials, including nova [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], which could be used to fund the invasion. Gunray wished to see direct evidence of Naboo's wealth, so he ordered OOM-9 to lead an attack on Spinnaker, occupy the town, and collect its supplies of nova crystals to present to him.<ref name="GB" />

A small Trade Federation presence had already been established near Spinnaker and was under the command of the battle droid [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[YIN-762]]. OOM-9, however, led his force of droidekas, AATs, [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] (MTT), [[Heavy Battle Droid/Legends|Heavy Battle Droids]], STAPs, and [[Grenade droid/Legends|grenade droids]] to a lightly defended [[Unidentified Naboo village (OOM-9)|village]] outside the town. The pacifist villagers, following [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] lead, offered little resistance, and the village quickly surrendered to the battle droids, relinquishing their resources and personnel to OOM-9's command.<ref name="GB" /> Positioning his forces to defend the village, the OOM commander set about forcing the scared population to work, gathering resources to assist the Trade Federation invasion and fortifying the village.<ref name="Prima" />

[[File:Pummels_burn_Spinnaker.png|thumb|right|290px|Trade Federation pummels attack a fortress in Spinnaker.]]
The invaders faced counterattacks by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] based in Spinnaker to the north and a [[Naboo Royal Navy]] base to the west.<ref name="GB" /> Summoning [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|air support]], OOM-9 took control of the road between the village and Spinnaker, allowing him to direct the bulk of his forces in an attack on the naval base. After using his ground forces to destroy its [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air turrets]], the command droid launched a combined ground and air attack, destroying the facility.<ref name="Prima" />

Turning his attention to Spinnaker itself, OOM-9 massed his forces at the town's southwestern gate. Using pummels to cut through the outer wall, he moved into the town, eliminating the anti-air defenses before sending in air support to eliminate any resistance. After pacifying the city and capturing its resources, OOM-9 sent a detachment to a small Naboo settlement to the north, forcing the settlers to supply their nova crystals to the Trade Federation.<ref name="Prima" /> With the nova crystals secured, the Trade Federation forces began preparing to take Theed and end the campaign, using Spinnaker as a launching point for the impending [[Capture of Theed]].<ref name="GB" />

===Fall of Theed===
{{Quote|You've captured the capital city of Theed. We are most pleased with you.|Nute Gunray, to OOM-9|audio=GunrayPleased-GB.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
With the surrounding countryside occupied, Federation forces approached the capital city. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] Amidala ordered the Royal Naboo Security Forces to stand down, but a signal jammer in the city prevented the approach of the Federation's [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Gunray ordered OOM-9 to lead a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of elite AATs, Heavy Battle Droids, STAPs, and pummels into Theed to eliminate the jammer and allow reinforcements to be sent in. He was also instructed to eliminate any military facilities they encountered and to avoid civilian casualties so as to prevent full-scale resistance.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:TheedAttack.png|thumb|left|330px|Trade Federation forces move into Theed.]]
With OOM-9 leading the way from his AAT, the Trade Federation forces destroyed the city gates and entered the capital, only to find that the Naboo had destroyed one of the bridges leading to the heart of the city, forcing them to take a longer route.<ref name="Prima" /> Despite Amidala's orders, the battle droids encountered scattered resistance from the Naboo military forces as they made their way through the city to the signal jammer.<ref name="GB" /> After destroying a Naboo [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], OOM-9 led his forces over another bridge deeper into the city, where his pummels made short work of a second fortress, clearing the way to the jamming device.<ref name="Prima" />

Once the forces had destroyed the jammer, Gunray ordered OOM-9 to proceed to the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], capture it, and prepare for the viceroy's arrival. To assist him, the Trade Federation sent reinforcements in the form of additional AATs and pummels along with droidekas, MTTs and [[OX9]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]].<ref name="GB" /> Landing in another part of the city, far from OOM-9's strike force, the reinforcements moved toward his location, and the two groups came together for the final push on the palace. Destroying fortresses and [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] along the way, the droid commander led the combined force into the palace grounds.<ref name="Prima" /> With assistance from air support, the battle droids fended off heavy counterattacks from Naboo forces until the palace was secured.<ref name="GB" />

===Occupation===
{{Dialogue|Gunray|Commander.|OOM-9|Yes, sir.|Gunray|Process them.|OOM-9|Captain, take them to Camp 4.|Captain|Roger, roger.|attr=Gunray, OOM-9, and a battle droid captain take Queen Amidala and her entourage prisoner|src=<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:OOM-9a.jpg|thumb|right|330px|OOM-9 is ordered to take Padmé Amidala for processing.]]
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of Gunray's and Haako's arrival, the capital was firmly under Trade Federation control.<ref name="TPM" /> OOM-9 remained in Theed, serving as personal guard to the viceroy.<ref name="GB" /> He was present in this capacity when Gunray met with Amidala and her senior aides. Gunray required Amidala to sign a treaty legitimizing the occupation, but when she proved uncooperative, he instructed OOM-9 to take her for processing.<ref name="TPM" />

With rumors passing through Federation-controlled Theed about an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Species/Legends|species]] residing in the outer [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]], OOM-9 computed that finding and eliminating the threat should be his top priority. He therefore delegated a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of his troopers with the task of escorting the queen<ref name="GB" /> to [[Camp Four/Legends|Camp Four]].<ref name="TPM" /> The command droid monitored the operation on a secure channel while remaining in the palace with the Neimoidians to remotely control the search for the Gungans.<ref name="GB" /> The escort operation to the detention camp, however, did not go as planned when Amidala was rescued by the two previously missing Jedi, who escorted her safely off Naboo.<ref name="TPM" />

===Search for the Gungans===
{{Quote|My troops are in position to begin searching the swamps for these rumored underwater villages. They will not stay hidden for long.|OOM-9|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:OOM9Reporting-TPM.png|thumb|left|330px|OOM-9 reports to Nute Gunray on the search for the Gungans.]]
OOM-9 received a lead on the Gungans' location when a captured [[Unidentified mariner|mariner]] from Harte Secur informed his captors of a Gungan city called [[Rellias]], which was connected to the Gungan capital [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] via the [[Rellias Straits|Rellias channel]]. Unaware of the city's exact location, the droid commander's forces established a forward observation base on the shore of a nearby marsh and had begun to scout the area when they were joined by Sidious's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who had recently arrived on Naboo. OOM-9 greeted the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and showed him to a group of Gungan prisoners captured while meeting with Naboo traders outside the city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]]. Seeking to end the search for the Gungans quickly, Maul ordered the command droid to begin poisoning the marsh to force the Gungans to the surface and to drain the [[Water/Legends|water]] if that proved unsuccessful.<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

When Maul departed soon after, OOM-9 did as instructed, but the droids discovered that the marsh was linked to vast reserves of underground water, and they had made little progress in draining it by the time Maul returned. However, while he was away, the Sith Lord had learned of Rellias's location from a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] surveyor named [[Leika]] and the name of its [[Governor/Legends|governor]], a Gungan named [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Ganne]].<ref name="EG" />

OOM-9 had his full contingent of droidekas and half of the droid troopers join him and Maul aboard an [[S-DST]], dispatching his STAP patrols ahead of the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] to saturate the area with [[depth charge]]s. As the Trade Federation forces approached Rellias, they came under fire from Gungan [[Booma/Legends|boomas]] and [[Submarine/Legends|submersibles]]. OOM-9's troopers quickly disembarked on the shore, where they were met by Gungan [[Kaadu/Legends|cavalry]] led by Boss Ganne. In the ensuing battle, Maul captured Boss Ganne<ref name="EG" /> and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to manipulate Ganne into opening the [[Gates of Rellias]], the only obstacle preventing Federation forces from accessing the Rellias channel. After eliminating all resistance from the Gungan defenders, the troops proceeded to the channel.<ref name="GB" />

===Siege of Otoh Gunga===
{{Quote|Scanners indicate the city is mostly deserted. Nevertheless, we must eliminate all remaining resistance.|OOM-9, during the siege of Otoh Gunga|audio=OtohGungaDeserted-GB.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The Rellias channel led to [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]], the location of Otoh Gunga. Upon arriving, the S-DST carrying OOM-9 and Maul was attacked by Gungans armed with boomas, but Maul had Ganne secured to the front of a vehicle like a figurehead, discouraging further attacks. With most of the STAPs destroyed during the capture of Ganne,<ref name="EG" /> OOM-9 had only a handful at his disposal. As his battle droids and droidekas provided cover, Trade Federation labor droids established an outpost on the shore of the lake, fortifying it against Gungan attacks with turrets.<ref name="Prima" />

[[File:Otoh_Gunga.png|thumb|right|330px|OOM-9 led the siege of the underwater Gungan city of Otoh Gunga.]]
OOM-9 sent patrols to locate any Gungan settlements on the mainland and the islands located in the lake.<ref name="Prima" /> Resources collected on the land were being used to supply Otoh Gunga,<ref name="GB" /> so the Trade Federation forces [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|destroyed]] the settlements and secured the resources, cutting the supply lines to the underwater city. The Gungans retaliated by sending their naval forces to attack the Trade Federation outpost, but OOM-9 repelled the counterattack, and his forces soon located Otoh Gunga itself.<ref name="Prima" />

Located under the surface of the lake, Otoh Gunga was protected by a series of turrets on the surface.<ref name="GB" /> Bringing in additional [[Navy/Legends|naval]] vessels, OOM-9 directed them to destroy the turrets, which left the city vulnerable to attack.<ref name="Prima" /> The command droid ordered his forces to deploy depth charges; when no Gungan bodies surfaced after the resulting explosions, he dispatched drone submersibles to scout the lake, confirming that the city had been virtually abandoned.<ref name="EG" />

While Maul interrogated Ganne as to his people's likely location,<ref name="EG" /> OOM-9 proceeded to eliminate the remaining resistance and laid waste to Otoh Gunga's [[High Board Room/Legends|High Tower Boardroom]] and much of the city.<ref name="Prima" /> With the apparent defeat of the Gungans, Naboo was firmly under Trade Federation control.<ref name="GB" /> Even so, OOM-9 was soon contacted by Gunray, and the droid commander relayed news to Maul that Amidala and the Jedi were returning to the planet.<ref name="EG" />

===Battle of the Great Grass Plains===
{{Quote|Open fire.|OOM-9, commanding the Battle of the Great Grass Plains|<ref name="TPM" />}}
OOM-9 returned to Theed<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> but was soon called into action once more. Amidala's [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]] was detected landing in the swamps, but a battle droid patrol found the ship abandoned, and Gunray ordered OOM-9 to make the queen's arrest his top priority.<ref name="EG" /> Having failed to secure help from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], Amidala united the scattered Naboo forces with the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].<ref name="TPM" />

The Gungans started recapturing city after city<ref name="GB" /> and were gathering at their [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|sacred place]] in preparation for an assault on Theed.<ref name="TPM" /> In response to the new threat, the battle droid commander increased security at the Naboo detention camps<ref name="TPM novel" /> before preparing to meet the approaching Grand Army.<ref name="TPM" /> However, the terrain thwarted his initial attempts to locate the Gungan forces, with long range battle droid patrols becoming mired in soft ground.<ref name="EG" />

[[File:OOM-9b.jpg|thumb|left|330px|OOM-9 oversees the Battle of the Great Grass Plains.]]
OOM-9 led the Trade Federation forces that finally [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|engaged]] the Grand Army on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]].<ref name="TPM" /> Upon receiving the command from the [[Vuutun Palaa|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]],<ref name="TPM novel" /> the droid commander ordered his AATs to open fire on the Gungan forces, but the Gungans' [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] successfully absorbed the barrage.<ref name="TPM" /> Emotionlessly observing the ineffectiveness of the attack<ref name="Mighty Chronicles">[[The Phantom Menace (Mighty Chronicles)|''The Phantom Menace'' Mighty Chronicles adaptation]]</ref> through his [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], OOM-9 ordered his forces to at last cease fire and deployed his battle droids,<ref name="TPM" /> knowing that they could walk through the shield to engage the Gungans.<ref name="Mighty Chronicles" />

As OOM-9 looked on, his forces proceeded to demolish the outgunned Gungans, sending them into a retreat after their shield finally fell to the onslaught.<ref name="TPM" /> The commander contacted his command ship to report the Gungan retreat and received orders to send his AATs in pursuit.<ref name="TPM novel" /> OOM-9 later deployed droidekas into the battle, which allowed the army to continue advancing further into the Gungan's shields.<ref name="Mighty Chronicles" /> Before long, the surviving Gungans were forced to surrender to the advancing battle droids. Only the actions of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the young [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of one of the Naboo [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle that was raging above, cost OOM-9 this final victory. Skywalker unintentionally managed to destroy the Trade Federation's [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|droid control ship]], deactivating OOM-9's [[Army/Legends|army]]<ref name="TPM" /> as well as the commander himself.<ref name="GB" /> By [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]'' to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> a manual regarding OOM-9 was written.<ref name="JQ">''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
{{Dialogue|Darth Maul|Who is supervising the search for the Gungan cities?|Nute Gunray|Commander OOM-Nine.|Darth Maul|A droid. The predecessor of your inept B-Ones.|Rune Haako|A superior droid, Lord Maul. Viceroy Gunray's personal guard.|attr=Darth Maul, Nute Gunray, and Rune Haako|src=<ref name="EG" />}}
[[File:OOM9OpenFire-TPM.png|thumb|right|330px|OOM-9 commands the droid army.]]
Starting out as a regular B1-Series battle droid,<ref name="GB" /> OOM-9 stood 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWCE" /> and had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]].<ref name="TPM" /> Like all battle droids, OOM-9 was created solely to wage war.<ref name="GB" /> OOM-9's legs were powered by high-torque motors and featured dried cartilage-shaped shin plates. The droid's feet could be replaced with claws or pads when required.<ref name="SWCE" />

OOM-9 was retrofitted following his promotion before the invasion of Naboo. He wore markings painted a dull mustard yellow, designating him as a commander. His original back plating was removed and replaced with the standard command backpack, including an advanced power supply<ref name="GB" /> to increase operational range and recharge intervals<ref name="VD" /> and several [[Antenna/Legends|antennae]] to allow him to communicate with the [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]] located in planetary orbit.<ref name="GB" />

OOM-9's additional programming, with the asssistance of the droid control ship, enabled him to collect tactical information, process reports, and make appropriate plans for battle.<ref name="SV49" /> The droid had [[Bone/Legends|bone]]-[[Color/Legends|white]] plating, black [[Photoreceptor/Legends|optical sensors]], and a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocoder]]<ref name="TPM" /> to allow him to communicate verbally with his superiors.<ref name="FF81" /> However, his personality was limited,<ref name="GB" /> with no expression on his metallic face and no inflection in his voice.<ref name="TPM novel" />

==Equipment==
In battle, OOM-9 coordinated the Trade Federation forces from his personal Heavy Armored Assault Tank,<ref name="GB" /> which was fitted with additional [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] and enhanced [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=AAT Assault Leader}}</ref> OOM-9 was armed with an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]]<ref name="GB" /> and carried macrobinoculars<ref name="TPM" /> with a stereo image [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]] and readings for enemy charge and mass.<ref name="VD" /> The macrobinoculars additionally transmitted images to the central droid control ship.<ref name="FF81" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We are sending all available troops to meet this army of hers. It appears to be assembling at the edge of the swamp. Primitives, my lord&mdash;nothing better. We do not expect much resistance.''"<br />"''I am increasing security at all Naboo detention camps.|Nute Gunray and OOM-9 report to Darth Sidious in the ''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization|<ref name="TPM novel" />}}
OOM-9 was created for [[George Lucas]]'s film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], in which he commands the battle droid army at the climactic Battle of the Great Grass Plains.<ref name="TPM" /> The film was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]],<ref name="TUVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> but the character first appeared in [[Terry Brooks]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]],<ref name="TPM novel" /> published on [[April 21]] of that year.<ref name="Noveldate">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The novelization mentions OOM-9's presence at a conversation between Darth Sidious, Darth Maul, and the senior Neimoidians, during which the droid reports on his response to the threat of the Gungan Grand Army.<ref name="TPM novel" /> However, he was omitted from the film's depiction of the scene.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:OOM9Storyboard-SWSTPT.png|thumb|left|300px|Storyboard for ''The Phantom Menace'' depicting OOM-9 during the Battle of Naboo]]
In ''The Phantom Menace'', OOM-9 is contacted by Gunray and Haako while he oversees the arrival of Trade Federation of landing craft on Naboo. During the conversation, Haako refers to OOM-9 as "[[Captain/Legends|captain]]." The droid is referred to as "commander" by Gunray later in the movie,<ref name="TPM" /> and this rank is also used in the novelization<ref name="TPM novel" /> and [[James Luceno]]'s short story "[[End Game]]," which was published in the [[2012]] re-release of ''The Phantom Menace'' novel.<ref name="EG" /> The reference to the lower rank of captain is not present in the version of the same scene in the finished screenplay, as printed in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay'']].<ref name="TPMIS">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref>

The character's background was expanded in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', in which he was voiced by [[Charles Martinet]]. The game presents a biography of the character, and the player controls OOM-9's forces in its first campaign, which depicts the early battles of the Trade Federation invasion of Naboo. The game also features a "what if" scenario in which Anakin Skywalker does not destroy the droid control ship. In the scenario, the player can lead OOM-9's forces to victory over the Gungans on the Great Grass Plains.<ref name="GB" />
